title: PROJECT_STATE
description: Git-native workflow state. Owned by the agent-workflow CLI; edit through commands, not by hand.

current_task.description: The single-task-mode active task id, or null when none is selected.

blocked.description: True when any task is blocked. Deferred (backlog) tasks do not count: they never block finalize.

completed_tasks.description: Task ids that have been completed.

in_progress.description: Task ids currently being worked (supports parallel agents).

unverified.description: Task ids completed without a passing Verify check (--force / --no-verify).

project_verify.description: Optional project-wide check run (in addition to the task's own Verify) on every task completion; a failure blocks completion.

format_version.description: Task file format: 2 = YAML frontmatter + ## sections, files named by id (T-001.md). Absent or 1 = legacy loose Key: value files; run `agent-workflow migrate`.

max_task_id.description: Highest task number ever issued. Retires ids of removed tasks so they are never reused.

block_reason.description: Why the project is blocked (set when a task is blocked).

claims.description: Task id -> { agent, ts } lock records for parallel scheduling.
